description: This file defines a static data provider class for tourist attractions in Sydney within an Android application. It includes constants, mappings of city locations, attraction details with images and descriptions, and methods for geofence creation and finding the closest city based on location.

classes.name: TouristAttractions
classes.description: A static data provider class containing tourist attraction data, city locations, geofence configurations, and utility methods.

methods.name: getGeofenceList
methods.description: Creates and returns a list of geofences for each city location.

methods.name: getClosestCity
methods.description: Determines and returns the name of the closest city to the provided latitude/longitude.
